=== about
ypy-refresh without a selector: the client fetches its own page and morphs the answer in.
=== page
<p id="n">1</p>
=== input
event: ypy-refresh
data: debounce 10

=== dom
<p id="n">2</p>
=== respond
@page => <div id="room" ypy-stream="/room" ypy-history-elt><p id="n">2</p></div>
=== requests
GET @page
